headline: Sensex and Nifty face volatility as IT stocks drag indices and crude oil prices fluctuate

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex fell 330 points with Nifty ending below 23,350 as IT stocks dragged the market down.
Fluctuations in global crude oil prices continue to influence domestic market sentiment.
US inflation risks persist while Richmond Fed officials note firming economic conditions.
Market participants monitor regulatory clearances and corporate deal announcements.
whatHappening: CCI approved Fairfax India's proposal to acquire an additional stake in IIFL Capital Services.
CCI cleared L'Oreal India's acquisition of personal care firm Onesto Labs.
Swan Defence announced plans to hire 550 additional personnel across white and blue-collar roles by March 2027.
Samsung India's FY26 profit declined by 36% due to rising royalties and falling export revenue.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices trade with negative bias as IT sector pressure drags Nifty below 23,350 amid shifting crude oil trends.
Regulatory approvals were granted by CCI for transactions involving IIFL Capital Services and Onesto Labs.
Key corporate updates include workforce expansion plans at Swan Defence and profit pressure at Samsung India.
